Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by insisting on verifying whether Sean Connor’s clubs were in the NIFL Premier Intermediate League during his playing years, introducing an unnecessary and impossible constraint (the league was formed long after his brief late-1980s career). This led to repetitive, circular search instructions without synthesis, instead of simply identifying the current PIL club he played for (Lisburn Distillery) and concluding.
